job.name: Maxwell — Lawrenceburg Admin Bldg Reno & Addition
job.scope_summary: Drywall and ACT ceilings for the admin building renovation and addition per plans and schedule.

line_items.detail:
Furnish and install three (3) ceiling types per plans and schedule:
APC-A: Armstrong Fine Fissured 2x2, 15/16" white grid
APC-B: Armstrong Clean Room VL 2x2, 15/16" white grid
APC-C: Armstrong Ultima High NRC 2x2 beveled tegular, 9/16" white grid
5/8" gypsum board at all new interior partitions; Type X at fire-rated assemblies; moisture-resistant board at restrooms; gypsum ceilings, soffits, and bulkheads. All surfaces finished to Level 5.
Prime and paint all new gypsum surfaces, two finish coats.

special_notes: Use 5/8" drywall throughout (supersedes our standard 1/2" deliverable).
All fire-rated assemblies per the life safety plan (1-hour and 2-hour).
estimate.notes: Lead time on ACT grid is approximately 3 weeks from approved submittals.
